title: Editor property catalog omits generator-supported accept_while_busy
summary: The current generator accepts accept_while_busy:boolean for inherited, switch, text, number and light properties, but the template-derived editor catalog omits it in all five contexts. This is source-confirmed on baseline af219db21 before this task and remains the single full editor attribute-contract failure after requested device-id/SDK-discover fixes. Next: scoped template/catalog correction with property context tests; no generator change or risk acceptance.
